title: A customer that bills itself shows no Bill Invoices To line
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself and has one contact, so the card has a Contacts counter to compare with.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page.
  2. Open customer A's Edit Customer window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The left card shows the Contacts counter.
  • The left card shows no "Bill Invoices To" line and no "Change".

Step 2:

  • The "Bill Invoices To" field shows "This customer": the default is set here, not on the card.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page)

  • S1-N1: “A customer that bills itself shows no "Bill Invoices To" line and no way to set one on the card; the default is set in New Customer or Edit Customer (Story 2).”
  • Key Decisions: “Bill To shows only where it differs from the customer.”
  • Feature Overview, Core Bill To: “The Bill To shows only where it differs from the customer. A customer that pays for itself sees nothing new on its documents.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: pictures "Customer page" (page 1 "Set a customer's default Bill To", Production (v26.45.2.1)), "Orchard City, Invoices" (page 5 "Getting paid", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

  • “S2-17513 was Orchard City's work but is not on its tab, so it cannot be paid from Orchard City's side.”
